in_hebrew.name: Davita
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Davita הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The Hebrew name Davita is derived from the Hebrew word 'davat' which means 'beloved'. In the Bible, the name Davita is not directly mentioned but it is derived from the name David, which means 'beloved'. Davita was a common name in ancient Judaism and it is believed to have been given to girls as a sign of affection and love.

in_latin.name: Davita
in_latin.meaning: Dea vita, meaning 'goddess of life, or life-giving'
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Davita, originem habet ab Hebraeo 'David', qui vocabulum significat 'amator', et 'ita', quod 'vita' significat; in contextu Christiano, Davita potest referri ad vitam Christi, et significare vitam aeternam, qua Deus nos donat.
